title: Proverbs 1:1 (#1)
content:
Who was the author of these proverbs?

Solomon, the king of Israel, was the author of these proverbs.

title: Proverbs 1:3 (#1)
content:
How do these proverbs teach people to live?

These proverbs teach people about what is insightful, righteous, just, and honest.

title: Proverbs 1:5 (#1)
content:
What can the wise and understanding receive by listening to these proverbs?

Wise people can increase their learning, and understanding people can acquire guidance by listening to these proverbs.

title: Proverbs 1:7 (#1)
content:
What is the beginning of knowledge?

The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge.

title: Proverbs 1:8 (#1)
content:
To whose instruction should a son listen?

A son should listen to instruction from his father and mother.

title: Proverbs 1:10 (#1)
content:
What should a son do if sinners try to entice him to sin?

A son should refuse to follow those who try to entice him to sin.

title: Proverbs 1:11–13 (#1)
content:
With what do those who are sinning plan to fill their houses?

Those who are sinning plan to fill their houses with what they steal from others.

title: Proverbs 1:15–16 (#1)
content:
What do those who are sinning hurry to do?

Those who are sinning hurry to do wicked things.

title: Proverbs 1:19 (#1)
content:
What does unjust gain do to those who gain unjustly?

Unjust gain will kill those who gain unjustly.

title: Proverbs 1:20–21 (#1)
content:
Who calls out in the streets, open areas, and city gates?

Wisdom calls out in open areas where busy streets intersect and at the entrance of the city gates.

title: Proverbs 1:24–25 (#1)
content:
What did those who lacked wisdom do when Wisdom called out to them?

Those who lacked wisdom ignored what Wisdom said and refused to listen when Wisdom called out to them.

title: Proverbs 1:26 (#1)
content:
What will Wisdom do when calamity comes on those who lack wisdom?

Wisdom will laugh when calamity comes on those who lack wisdom.

title: Proverbs 1:28 (#1)
content:
What will Wisdom do when those who lack wisdom call upon her?

Wisdom will not answer when those who lack wisdom call upon her.

title: Proverbs 1:31 (#1)
content:
With what will those who lack wisdom be filled?

Those who lack wisdom will suffer rightly for their plans and for what they have done.

title: Proverbs 1:33 (#1)
content:
How will those live who listen to Wisdom?

Those who listen to Wisdom will live safely and not dread evil.

title: Proverbs 2:1 (#1)
content:
What does the father want his son to store up as precious?

The father wants his son to consider his commandments to be precious.

title: Proverbs 2:3–4 (#1)
content:
How should the son seek and search for insight and understanding?

The son should seek insight and understanding as silver, and search for it as a hidden treasure.

title: Proverbs 2:4–5 (#1)
content:
If the son seeks and searches for understanding as silver, what will he find?

The son will find the knowledge of God.

title: Proverbs 2:6–7 (#1)
content:
What is Yahweh for those who walk in integrity?

Yahweh is a shield for those who walking with integrity.

title: Proverbs 2:9–10 (#1)
content:
When wisdom comes into the son’s heart, what will he understand?

The son will understand righteousness, justice, and integrity.

title: Proverbs 2:11–12 (#1)
content:
From what will discretion and understanding rescue the son?

Discretion and understanding will rescue the son from the way of evil and from people who speak perversely.

title: Proverbs 2:13 (#1)
content:
What do those who walk in the ways of darkness forsake?

Those who walk in the ways of darkness forsake the paths of straightness, they refuse to behave righteously.

title: Proverbs 2:16–17 (#1)
content:
What does the strange woman forsake and forget?

The strange woman forsakes the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.

title: Proverbs 2:18 (#1)
content:
To where do the immoral woman’s tracks lead?

The immoral woman’s tracks lead down to death.

title: Proverbs 2:20 (#1)
content:
In whose way should the son walk?

The son should walk, or behave like a righteous person.

title: Proverbs 2:21 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who live uprightly?

People who live uprightly will stay in this land for a long time.

title: Proverbs 2:22 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who are wicked?

Those who are wicked will be removed from the land.

title: Proverbs 3:1–2 (#1)
content:
What will the father’s commands and teachings add to his son?

The father’s commands and teachings will add years of life and peace to his son.

title: Proverbs 3:3 (#1)
content:
Where must covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness be written?

Covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness must be written on the tablet of one’s heart.

title: Proverbs 3:5 (#1)
content:
On what must the son not lean?

The son must not lean on (rely on) his own understanding.

title: Proverbs 3:7 (#1)
content:
How must the son not see himself?

The son must not see himself as wise.

title: Proverbs 3:9 (#1)
content:
What must the son do with his wealth?

The son must honor Yahweh with his wealth.

acai.preferred_label: Bring Honor and Glory on Oneself

title: Proverbs 3:12 (#1)
content:
Whom does Yahweh discipline?

Yahweh disciplines those whom he loves.

title: Proverbs 3:13–14 (#1)
content:
What benefits people more than having silver or gold?

Being wise benefits people more than silver could benefit them. Indeed, being wise is worth more to people than having gold.

title: Proverbs 3:17 (#1)
content:
What are all the paths of wisdom?

All the paths of wisdom are peace.

title: Proverbs 3:19 (#1)
content:
What did Yahweh do by being wise?

Yahweh made the world through being wise.

title: Proverbs 3:21–22 (#1)
content:
What will be life to the son’s soul?

Prudence and discretion will be life to the son’s soul.

title: Proverbs 3:24 (#1)
content:
If the son walks in wisdom, what will happen when he lies down?

When he lies down, he will not fear anything, and he will sleep peacefully.

title: Proverbs 3:25 (#1)
content:
Of what should the son not be afraid?

The son should not be afraid of sudden dread or devastation.

title: Proverbs 3:27 (#1)
content:
What should the son do for those who deserve it?

The son should not withhold what is good from people who deserve it.

title: Proverbs 3:29 (#1)
content:
What should the son not do to his neighbor?

The son should not make a plan to harm his neighbor.

title: Proverbs 3:32 (#1)
content:
Who does Yahweh detest?

Yahweh detests people who act wickedly.

title: Proverbs 3:34 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do to the mockers?

Yahweh himself mocks the mockers.

title: Proverbs 3:35 (#1)
content:
What do the wise inherit?

The wise inherit honor.

title: Proverbs 4:1–2 (#1)
content:
What should the sons not forget?

The sons should not forget their father’s instruction.

title: Proverbs 4:4 (#1)
content:
How did the father tell the son he would live?

The father told the son he would live by keeping the father’s commands.

title: Proverbs 4:6 (#1)
content:
What will Wisdom do for the son if the son does not forsake her, but loves her?

Wisdom will watch over him and keep him safe.

title: Proverbs 4:8–9 (#1)
content:
What will Wisdom do for the son if the son cherishes and embraces her?

Wisdom will honor him, as if putting a crown of splendor on his head.

acai.preferred_label: Bring Honor and Glory on Oneself

title: Proverbs 4:11 (#1)
content:
In what way did the father teach the son?

The father taught the son in the way of wisdom and directed him in how to live in the right way.

title: Proverbs 4:13 (#1)
content:
On to what must the son grasp, for it is his life?

The son must consistently remember the things his father has instructed him, for it is his life.

title: Proverbs 4:14–15 (#1)
content:
What path must the son avoid?

The son must avoid the path of the wicked ones.

title: Proverbs 4:16 (#1)
content:
What do the wicked do before they can sleep?

The wicked feel that they must do evil before they can sleep.

title: Proverbs 4:18 (#1)
content:
What is the path of the righteous like?

The path of the righteous is like the light of the sun that grows brighter until the brightest time of day.

title: Proverbs 4:19 (#1)
content:
What is the way of the wicked like?

The way of the wicked is like the darkness.

title: Proverbs 4:23 (#1)
content:
Why must the son guard his heart extremely carefully?

The son must guard his heart extremely carefully, for from it are the sources of life.

title: Proverbs 4:24 (#1)
content:
What kind of speech and talk must the son put away?

The son must put away speech that deceives or misleads people.

title: Proverbs 4:25 (#1)
content:
Where must the son focus his gaze?

The son must focus his gaze on doing what is right.

title: Proverbs 5:1–2 (#1)
content:
What will the son learn if he listens carefully to what he should understand?

If he listens carefully to what he should understand, the son will learn to be able to choose wisely what to do, and to know the right things to say.

title: Proverbs 5:3–4 (#1)
content:
What will happen to you after being with an adulteress woman?

After being with such a woman you will be miserable, as if you had eaten a bitter plant.

title: Proverbs 5:5 (#1)
content:
To where are such a woman’s feet going?

Her feet are going down to death.

title: Proverbs 5:7–8 (#1)
content:
What advice does the father give the sons about getting near any adulterous woman?

The sons are to keep far away from any adulterous woman and not even go near her house.

title: Proverbs 5:9 (#1)
content:
What will the son give away if he goes to such a woman?

If he goes to such a woman, the son will give away the best efforts of his youth.

title: Proverbs 5:11 (#1)
content:
What will happen at the end of his life if the son becomes involved with an adulterous woman?

If the son becomes involved with an adulterous woman, he will groan when he is about to die.

title: Proverbs 5:12 (#1)
content:
What will the son say at the end of his life if he becomes involved with an adulterous woman?

If he becomes involved with an adulterous woman, he will say that he hated correction and despised rebuke.

title: Proverbs 5:15 (#1)
content:
From where should the sons drink?

The sons should only drink water from their own well, which means to have sex with his wife only.

title: Proverbs 5:18 (#1)
content:
Whom should the son enjoy sexually?

The father tells the son to enjoy sexually the woman whom he married when he was young.

title: Proverbs 5:18–19 (#1)
content:
With what should the a son be exhilarated?

He should be exhilarated by how the wife of his youth loves him.

title: Proverbs 5:21 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh observe?

Yahweh knows everything that people do.

title: Proverbs 5:22 (#1)
content:
What will capture and grasp the wicked person?

The wicked things that the wicked one does will capture him and his sin will be like cords that grasp him.

title: Proverbs 6:1–2 (#1)
content:
How could the son be caught by what he says with his mouth?

The son could regret what he says if he guarantees a loan for a stranger.

title: Proverbs 6:3 (#1)
content:
What must the son do to save himself?

To save himself the son must humbly go to that person and beg him to cancel what the son has promised.

title: Proverbs 6:6 (#1)
content:
From what should a lazy person learn?

A lazy person should consider the ant, see its ways, and learn to be wise.

title: Proverbs 6:8 (#1)
content:
What does the ant do in the summer?

In the summer, the ant gathers and stores food to eat during the winter.

title: Proverbs 6:9,11 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the lazy person who does not rise from his sleep?

He will become poor and needy just as surely as if a thief has robbed him.

title: Proverbs 6:12 (#1)
content:
How would you describe worthless people?

Worthless, sinful people are people who constantly deceive other people by what they say.

title: Proverbs 6:14–15 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the wicked man because of his evil plots?

He will be suddenly destroyed and unable to recover.

title: Proverbs 6:16 (#1)
content:
How many things does Yahweh hate and how many things are abominations to him?

There are six things that Yahweh hates, seven that are abominations to him.

title: Proverbs 6:18 (#1)
content:
What kind of heart does Yahweh hate?

Yahweh hates the heart of someone planning ways to act sinfully.

title: Proverbs 6:19 (#1)
content:
What kind of witness does Yahweh hate?

Yahweh hates the witness who lies when testifying.

title: Proverbs 6:23 (#1)
content:
To what are commandment and law likened?

Commandment is likened to a lamp and the law is likened to a light.

title: Proverbs 6:26 (#1)
content:
What can having sex with the wife of another cost the son?

Having sex with the wife of another will cause him to die.

title: Proverbs 6:30 (#1)
content:
Why might people not despise a thief if he steals?

People do not despise someone who steals if he only steals food because he is hungry.

title: Proverbs 6:32 (#1)
content:
Who does a man who commits adultery destroy?

A man who commits adultery with a woman destroys himself.

title: Proverbs 6:34–35 (#1)
content:
What will the one who takes revenge against adultery not accept?

That jealous husband will not accept any money to stop being furious, no matter how much money you offer him.

title: Proverbs 7:1–2 (#1)
content:
What must the son keep in order to live?

The son must keep his father’s sayings and commandments to live.

title: Proverbs 7:4–5 (#1)
content:
From whom do Wisdom and Understanding keep the son?

Wisdom and Understanding keep the son from immoral women who speak to him seductively.

title: Proverbs 7:6–7 (#1)
content:
Who did Solomon notice as he looked out through the window?

Solomon noticed a young man who does not think wisely.

title: Proverbs 7:10 (#1)
content:
What was the woman wearing who approached the young man?

She was wearing a prostitute’s clothing.

title: Proverbs 7:12 (#1)
content:
What does the woman do at every corner?

At the corner of any road, she waits for a man whom she can seduce.

title: Proverbs 7:14 (#1)
content:
What had the woman done that day?

That day, the woman had sacrificed an animal.

title: Proverbs 7:15 (#1)
content:
For what does the woman look everywhere?

The woman is looking everywhere for the young man.

title: Proverbs 7:18 (#1)
content:
What does the woman invite the young man to do?

The woman invites the young man to come with her so they can satisfy themselves with lovemaking until the morning.

title: Proverbs 7:19 (#1)
content:
Where is the woman’s husband?

The woman’s husband is away from home on a long journey.

title: Proverbs 7:22 (#1)
content:
In what way does the young man follow after the woman?

The young man follows quickly after the woman, going like an ox to its slaughter.

title: Proverbs 7:23 (#1)
content:
What will the young man’s actions cost him?

The young man’s actions will cause him to die.

title: Proverbs 7:25 (#1)
content:
What wise instruction is the young man given about an adulterous woman?

He is instructed to not desire her and to never go with her.

title: Proverbs 7:27 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who enter her bedroom?

Those who enter her bedroom will die as a result.

title: Proverbs 8:1–2 (#1)
content:
Who calls out beside the road?

Wisdom calls out next to the crowded crossroads where everyone can hear her.

title: Proverbs 8:4 (#1)
content:
To whom does Wisdom call?

Wisdom calls to all people.

title: Proverbs 8:6 (#1)
content:
What kinds of things does Wisdom speak?

Wisdom speaks of noble things and of what is right.

title: Proverbs 8:11 (#1)
content:
What is wisdom more valuable than?

Wisdom is more valuable than having precious jewels.

title: Proverbs 8:13 (#1)
content:
What do those who fear Yahweh hate?

Those who fear Yahweh hate evil, pride, arrogance, and perverted speech.

title: Proverbs 8:15–16 (#1)
content:
How do kings and princes who have Wisdom rule?

Kings and princes who have Wisdom rule well.

title: Proverbs 8:19 (#1)
content:
What is the fruit of Wisdom better than?

The fruit of Wisdom is better than purest gold and the best silver.

title: Proverbs 8:21 (#1)
content:
What will Wisdom give to those who love her?

Wisdom will give an inheritance to those who love her.

title: Proverbs 8:23 (#1)
content:
When was Wisdom established?

Wisdom was established a very long time ago, before the world existed.

title: Proverbs 8:26–27 (#1)
content:
Where was Wisdom when Yahweh made the earth and heavens?

Wisdom was there when Yahweh made the earth and heavens.

title: Proverbs 8:30 (#1)
content:
What was Wisdom doing beside Yahweh when he made everything?

Wisdom was beside Yahweh helping him to create everything.

title: Proverbs 8:31 (#1)
content:
What was Wisdom’s delight?

Wisdom’s delight was the people he made.

title: Proverbs 8:35 (#1)
content:
What does one who finds Wisdom also find and obtain?

One who finds Wisdom also finds life and obtains favor from Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 8:36 (#1)
content:
What happens to the who fails to find Wisdom?

One who fails to find Wisdom hurts himself.

title: Proverbs 9:1 (#1)
content:
What has Wisdom built?

Wisdom has built her own house.

title: Proverbs 9:3–4 (#1)
content:
To whom are the invitations that Wisdom sends out directed?

The invitations Wisdom sends out are directed to those who are not wise.

title: Proverbs 9:6 (#1)
content:
What does Wisdom say to forsake?

Wisdom says to stop acting naively so that you can live well.

title: Proverbs 9:8 (#1)
content:
What happens to one who rebukes a mocker?

If you rebuke a mocker, that person will hate you.

title: Proverbs 9:8 (#2)
content:
What happens to one who corrects a wise person?

If you correct a wise person, that person will love you for doing so.

title: Proverbs 9:10 (#2)
content:
What is understanding?

The knowledge of the holy things is understanding.

title: Proverbs 9:10 (#1)
content:
What is the beginning of wisdom?

The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.

title: Proverbs 9:13 (#1)
content:
What are the characteristics of a foolish woman?

A foolish woman speaks loudly, acts naively, but she does not know anything.

title: Proverbs 9:18 (#1)
content:
Who are in the foolish woman’s house?

Those in the foolish woman’s house are now in the deepest parts of the place where dead people are.

title: Proverbs 10:1 (#1)
content:
How do fathers react to wise children?

Wise children make their fathers glad.

title: Proverbs 10:3 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do to the desire of the wicked?

Yahweh prevents wicked people from getting what they want.

title: Proverbs 10:4 (#1)
content:
What becomes of people who are lazy?

People who are lazy become poor.

title: Proverbs 10:6 (#1)
content:
How does God treat righteous people?

God blesses righteous people.

title: Proverbs 10:8 (#1)
content:
What happens to people who speak foolishly?

People who speak foolishly destroy themselves.

title: Proverbs 10:12 (#1)
content:
What does love cover?

Love covers over all transgressions.

title: Proverbs 10:13 (#1)
content:
What is found on the lips of a discerning person?

Wisdom is found on the lips of a discerning person.

title: Proverbs 10:17 (#1)
content:
What happens to people who do not let others correct them?

People who do not let others correct them do what will destroy them.

title: Proverbs 10:19 (#1)
content:
What happens when there are many words?

People who talk a lot sin a lot.

title: Proverbs 10:22 (#1)
content:
In what does the blessing of Yahweh result?

It is because Yahweh is blessing them that people become wealthy.

title: Proverbs 10:25 (#1)
content:
What results when something disastrous happens?

When something disastrous happens, it destroys wicked people.

title: Proverbs 10:26 (#1)
content:
How do lazy people impact those who send them to do something?

A lazy person is like smoke in the eyes that irritates those who send him.

title: Proverbs 10:27 (#1)
content:
How long will the years of the wicked ones be?

The years of the wicked ones will be short.

title: Proverbs 10:29 (#1)
content:
Who does the way of Yahweh protect?

The way of Yahweh protects those with integrity who are honest people.

title: Proverbs 10:31 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh do to those who speak perversely?

Yahweh will stop people from speaking who speak perversely.

title: Proverbs 11:2 (#1)
content:
What comes before disgrace?

Presumptuousness or acting proudly comes before disgrace.

title: Proverbs 11:4 (#1)
content:
What is valuable when Yahweh punishes wicked people?

Righteousness, not wealth, is valuable when Yahweh punishes wicked people.

title: Proverbs 11:6 (#1)
content:
What traps the treacherous people?

Desiring bad things will cause people who act treacherously to trap themselves.

title: Proverbs 11:8 (#1)
content:
What keeps a person away from distress?

A righteous person will be drawn away from distress.

title: Proverbs 11:9 (#1)
content:
How does the godless person destroy other people?

A godless person destroys others by what they say.

title: Proverbs 11:13 (#1)
content:
What does a faithful person do instead of gossiping?

A faithful person will keep a matter private instead of gossiping.

title: Proverbs 11:15 (#1)
content:
What will happen if a person guarantees to pay a debt for someone they do not know?

A person who guarantees to pay a debt for someone they do not know will surely suffer.

title: Proverbs 11:18 (#1)
content:
What wage does a wicked person make?

The wage of a wicked person is falsehood because they falsely believe that they have gained something good.

title: Proverbs 11:20 (#1)
content:
In whom does Yahweh delight?

Yahweh delights in those who act blamelessly.

title: Proverbs 11:21 (#1)
content:
Of what can everyone be certain?

It is certain that the wicked will be punished and the righteous will be safely escape punishment.

title: Proverbs 11:24 (#1)
content:
What happens to the one who generously shares what they have with others?

Those who generously share with others receive even more.

title: Proverbs 11:28 (#1)
content:
What happens to the one who trusts in his riches?

The one who depends on his riches will not be successful.

title: Proverbs 11:30 (#1)
content:
What is a tree of life?

The fruit of the righteous, what righteous people say and do, is like a tree with fruit that keeps people alive.

title: Proverbs 11:31 (#1)
content:
Who will receive what they deserve?

Those who are righteous will be repaid, and much more the wicked and the sinner will get what they deserve.

title: Proverbs 12:1 (#1)
content:
What does a person who accepts correction love?

A person who accepts correction loves learning what they should know.

title: Proverbs 12:2 (#1)
content:
Whom does Yahweh condemn?

Yahweh condemns a person who plans to do what is evil.

title: Proverbs 12:4 (#1)
content:
What is a husband’s crown?

A virtuous wife is a husband’s crown.

title: Proverbs 12:5 (#1)
content:
What kind of directions do the wicked give?

The wicked give deceitful directions.

title: Proverbs 12:7 (#1)
content:
What happens to the families of those who are righteous?

The families of the righteous will continue.

title: Proverbs 12:10 (#1)
content:
Who is it that cares for their animals?

Righteous people care for their animals.

title: Proverbs 12:13 (#1)
content:
What destroys an evil person?

The sinful things that wicked people say will destroy them.

title: Proverbs 12:15 (#1)
content:
How does a fool think of what he is doing?

A fool thinks that what he is doing is right.

title: Proverbs 12:18 (#1)
content:
What are words spoken thoughtlessly like?

Words spoken thoughtlessly are like the thrusts of a sword; they hurt others.

title: Proverbs 12:20 (#1)
content:
What is in the heart of those who plan evil?

Deceit is in the heart of those who plan evil.

title: Proverbs 12:22 (#1)
content:
What is an abomination to Yahweh?

Yahweh detests people who speak falsely.

title: Proverbs 12:24 (#1)
content:
What happens to lazy people?

Lazy people will become forced laborers.

title: Proverbs 12:26 (#1)
content:
Where does the way of the wicked lead them?

The way of the wicked leads them astray; by living wickedly, they destroy themselves.

title: Proverbs 12:28 (#1)
content:
What becomes of people who do what is righteous?

People who do what is righteous will live.

title: Proverbs 13:1 (#1)
content:
To what does a wise son listen?

A wise son listens to his father’s instruction.

title: Proverbs 13:3 (#1)
content:
How does a person keep his life?

A person keeps his life by guarding his mouth.

title: Proverbs 13:4 (#1)
content:
Who wants things very much and gets very little?

A lazy person wants things very much and gets very little.

title: Proverbs 13:8 (#1)
content:
What might a rich person have to do in order to stay alive?

A rich person might have to pay out of his riches as a ransom to someone who threatens him.

title: Proverbs 13:10 (#1)
content:
What happens with people who act proudly?

People who act proudly cause people to argue.

title: Proverbs 13:11 (#1)
content:
What kind of wealth dwindles away?

Wealth that people gain without working for it will disappear.

title: Proverbs 13:14 (#1)
content:
What benefits people throughout their lives?

The law of the wise, that which wise people teach, benefits people throughout their lives.

title: Proverbs 13:16 (#1)
content:
How do prudent people show they are prudent?

The prudent think carefully before they do something.

title: Proverbs 13:18 (#1)
content:
What will happen to those who let other people rebuke them?

Those who let other people rebuke them for any bad behavior will be honored.

acai.preferred_label: Bring Honor and Glory on Oneself

title: Proverbs 13:20 (#1)
content:
With whom should a person walk in order to become wise?

In order to be wise, a person should associate with wise people.

title: Proverbs 13:22 (#1)
content:
For whom is a sinner’s wealth stored up?

A sinner’s wealth is stored up for righteous people.

title: Proverbs 13:24 (#1)
content:
How do parents treat their children if they love them?

Parents who truly love their children are careful to discipline them.

title: Proverbs 13:25 (#1)
content:
In what condition will the stomach of the wicked be?

The stomach of the wicked will be hungry.

title: Proverbs 14:1 (#1)
content:
What do the wisest women do?

The wisest women help their families to thrive.

title: Proverbs 14:2 (#1)
content:
Who despises Yahweh?

People who behave deceptively show that they despise Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 14:5 (#1)
content:
What will an honest witness not do?

A witness of who is honest will not lie.

title: Proverbs 14:7 (#1)
content:
What will happen if you associate with foolish people?

If you associate with foolish people, you will not learn anything from knowledgeable people.

title: Proverbs 14:11 (#2)
content:
What will happen to the tent of the upright?

The tent of the upright will flourish.

title: Proverbs 14:11 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the house of the wicked?

The house of the wicked will be destroyed.

title: Proverbs 14:14 (#1)
content:
What will happen to people who refuse to live righteously?

People who refuse to live righteously will receive from Yahweh what they deserve from living that way.

title: Proverbs 14:16 (#1)
content:
Does a fool turn away from trouble?

No, a fool confidently interferes in other people’s business.

title: Proverbs 14:17 (#1)
content:
What does someone do who quickly becomes angry?

A person who quickly becomes angry acts foolishly.

title: Proverbs 14:19 (#1)
content:
To whom will evil people bow down?

Some day, evil people will bow down in front of good people.

title: Proverbs 14:22 (#1)
content:
How does Solomon describe those people who plan to do good?

Those who plan to do good are faithful and trustworthy people.

title: Proverbs 14:23 (#1)
content:
What will people gain if they talk but do not work hard?

If people work hard, they will gain from it, but if people only talk, they will remain poor.

title: Proverbs 14:27 (#1)
content:
What is a fountain of life?

The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life which is like a refreshing spring that enables people to live well.

title: Proverbs 14:29 (#1)
content:
Who shows everyone how foolish they are?

People who quickly become angry show everyone how foolish they are.

title: Proverbs 14:31 (#1)
content:
Who taunts his maker by his actions?

A person who oppresses poor people is taunting Yahweh, his maker.

acai.preferred_label: Bring Honor and Glory on Oneself

title: Proverbs 14:34 (#1)
content:
What kind of behavior makes a country great?

Acting righteously makes a country great.

title: Proverbs 15:1 (#1)
content:
What kind of answer calms angry people?

Replying gently to angry people will calm them.

title: Proverbs 15:3 (#1)
content:
Whom does Yahweh watch?

Yahweh watches both the evil and the good.

title: Proverbs 15:5 (#1)
content:
What is a fool’s attitude toward his father’s correction?

A fool despises the correction of his father.

title: Proverbs 15:8 (#1)
content:
What kind of sacrifice does Yahweh detest?

The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 15:10 (#1)
content:
What happens to the person who forsakes God’s path?

Yahweh will severely punish the person who refuses to live righteously.

title: Proverbs 15:13 (#1)
content:
What makes the face glad?

A joyful heart makes the face glad.

title: Proverbs 15:16 (#1)
content:
What is better than being rich while worrying?

Being poor while reverently fearing Yahweh is better than being rich while worrying.

title: Proverbs 15:18 (#1)
content:
What kind of person quiets a dispute?

A person who does not easily become angry will help people to be peaceful.

title: Proverbs 15:20 (#1)
content:
How does a wise son affect his father?

A wise son gladdens his father.

title: Proverbs 15:22 (#1)
content:
What causes people’s plans to succeed?

When many people advise them well, they will succeed.

title: Proverbs 15:25 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh tear down?

Yahweh will tear down what a proud person owns.

title: Proverbs 15:28 (#1)
content:
What does the righteous person do before answering?

The righteous person thinks carefully before answering.

title: Proverbs 15:31 (#1)
content:
Where will the person live who behaves better after hearing a rebuke?

The person who behaves better after hearing a rebuke will live among people who are wise.

title: Proverbs 15:33 (#1)
content:
What teaches a person to be wise?

A reverent fear of Yahweh teaches a person to be wise.

title: Proverbs 16:2 (#1)
content:
How do all of a person’s ways appear to himself?

All of a person’s ways are pure in his own eyes.

title: Proverbs 16:4 (#1)
content:
For what has Yahweh made everything?

Yahweh has made everything for its purpose.

title: Proverbs 16:6 (#1)
content:
By what is sin forgiven?

By covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness sin is forgiven.

title: Proverbs 16:9 (#1)
content:
Once a person plans out his way, what does Yahweh do?

A person plans out what he wants to do, but Yahweh determines what he will actually do.

title: Proverbs 16:12 (#1)
content:
How is a throne established?

A throne is established by righteousness.

title: Proverbs 16:14 (#1)
content:
What is a messenger of death?

A king’s anger is a messenger of death.

title: Proverbs 16:16 (#1)
content:
What should be chosen more than gold and silver?

Wisdom and understanding should be chosen more than gold and silver.

title: Proverbs 16:18 (#1)
content:
What causes people to ruin themselves?

Being arrogant causes people to ruin themselves.

title: Proverbs 16:20 (#1)
content:
What makes a person happy?

A person who trusts in Yahweh is happy.

title: Proverbs 16:23 (#1)
content:
What happens when the wise speak insightfully?

When the wise speak insightfully, what they say causes others to learn.

title: Proverbs 16:25 (#1)
content:
Even though a way to do things may seem easy and convenient for people, where can it end?

In the end, doing things that way will cause them to die.

title: Proverbs 16:28 (#1)
content:
What separates friends?

People who gossip about others cause friends to stop being friends.

title: Proverbs 16:30 (#1)
content:
What is the one who signals with his eyes doing?

The one who signals others with his eyes is about to do something perverse.

title: Proverbs 16:31 (#1)
content:
What is a crown of splendor?

Gray hair is like an honorable crown on the head.

title: Proverbs 16:32 (#1)
content:
Who is it better to be than one capturing a city?

It is better to be someone who does not become angry quickly than to be powerful and capture a city.

title: Proverbs 16:33 (#1)
content:
How is the decision of casting lots made?

Yahweh decides whatever happens.

title: Proverbs 17:2 (#1)
content:
What does an insightful servant do with regard to a shameful son?

An insightful servant will rule over a shameful son.

title: Proverbs 17:4 (#1)
content:
To what does an evildoer listen carefully?

An evildoer will listen carefully when people say sinful things that destroy others.

title: Proverbs 17:5 (#1)
content:
What happens to those who rejoice when someone experiences calamity?

Yahweh will certainly punish people who rejoice when others experience disastrous things.

title: Proverbs 17:8 (#1)
content:
Why do people who pay bribes think that bribes are magical?

They think that, by paying bribes, everything they do will be successful.

title: Proverbs 17:10 (#1)
content:
What causes a sensible person to learn?

Rebuking a sensible person once causes him to learn.

title: Proverbs 17:12 (#1)
content:
What is more dangerous than meeting a mother bear robbed of her cubs?

It can be more dangerous to confront a foolish person who is doing something foolish.

title: Proverbs 17:14 (#1)
content:
What should a person do before a dispute breaks out?

A person should leave the dispute before it breaks out because once an argument has started, it will be as difficult to stop as it is to stop water that is leaking.

title: Proverbs 17:15 (#1)
content:
What two types of people are an abomination to Yahweh?

A person who declares a wicked person as righteous and one who declares a righteous person as wicked are both an abomination to Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 17:18 (#1)
content:
What does a man do who does not think wisely?

A man who does not think wisely agrees to pay someone else’s loan.

title: Proverbs 17:20 (#1)
content:
What causes a person to experience bad things?

Bad things will happen to a person who thinks and speaks deceitfully.

title: Proverbs 17:22 (#1)
content:
What helps the body to heal?

A joyful heart helps the body to heal.

title: Proverbs 17:25 (#1)
content:
What is a foolish son to his father and mother?

A foolish son is a grief to his father and bitterness to his mother.

title: Proverbs 17:28 (#1)
content:
How can a fool be considered wise?

A fool can be considered wise if he keeps silent.

title: Proverbs 18:2 (#1)
content:
In what does a foolish person not find delight?

A foolish person hates learning and does not delight in understanding.

title: Proverbs 18:3 (#1)
content:
How is a wicked person treated?

A wicked person is treated with contempt and a person who acts shamefully, with reproach.

title: Proverbs 18:6 (#1)
content:
What happens when a foolish person speaks?

What a foolish person says makes people argue and want to beat him.

title: Proverbs 18:8 (#1)
content:
What deeply affects those who hear it?

What people who gossip say deeply affects those who hear it.

title: Proverbs 18:10 (#1)
content:
What is a tower of strength?

The name of Yahweh is like a strong tower into which the righteous can run and be safe.

title: Proverbs 18:12 (#1)
content:
What must a person become before others will honor and respect him?

A person must become humble before others will respect him.

title: Proverbs 18:14 (#1)
content:
When is it difficult to make someone feel better?

When they are inwardly weak and depressed.

title: Proverbs 18:17 (#1)
content:
Who seems right at first?

The first person to state his case seems to be right until people whom he knows arrive and question him.

title: Proverbs 18:19 (#1)
content:
What is more difficult to do than to conquer a fortified city?

It is more difficult to reconcile with an offended relative than it is to conquer a fortified city.

title: Proverbs 18:21 (#1)
content:
What strongly influences what happens to people?

What people say can influence what happens, even to cause people to die or to remain alive.

title: Proverbs 18:23 (#1)
content:
How does a rich person answer others?

A rich person answers others harshly.

title: Proverbs 19:2 (#1)
content:
What must a person have in addition to zeal?

A person must have knowledge in addition to zeal.

title: Proverbs 19:5 (#1)
content:
What will happen to a person who is a false witness?

Someone will surely punish people who lie easily.

title: Proverbs 19:7 (#1)
content:
What happens when a poor man calls out to his friends?

When a poor man calls out to his friends, they are gone.

title: Proverbs 19:8 (#1)
content:
What does a person do who loves his life?

A person who loves his life loves to learn.

title: Proverbs 19:11 (#1)
content:
What does a person with insight do when offended?

Insightful people do not get angry quickly.

title: Proverbs 19:13 (#1)
content:
What is like a constant dripping of water?

A quarreling wife is like a constant dripping of water.

title: Proverbs 19:14 (#1)
content:
From where does a insightful wife come?

An insightful wife is from Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 19:17 (#1)
content:
How does a person lend to Yahweh?

Giving things to poor people is like loaning them to Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 19:19 (#1)
content:
Who will have to be rescued a second time?

A very angry person will have to be rescued a second time.

title: Proverbs 19:20 (#1)
content:
How can a person become wise for the rest of his life?

A person can become wise for the rest of your life by paying attention to what people advise them and by accepting instruction.

title: Proverbs 19:23 (#1)
content:
What leads people to live for a long time?

Revering Yahweh causes people to live for a long time.

title: Proverbs 19:24 (#1)
content:
What will a lazy one not do?

A lazy one will not even lift the food to his mouth.

title: Proverbs 19:26 (#1)
content:
What does a child cause who does violence to his father and causes his mother to flee?

A child who does violence to his father and causes his mother to flee causes shame and embarrassment.

title: Proverbs 19:28 (#1)
content:
What kind of witness mocks justice?

A worthless witness scorns what is just.

title: Proverbs 20:2 (#1)
content:
What is the anger of a king compared to?

The king’s anger can frighten people like the roaring of a lion.

title: Proverbs 20:3 (#1)
content:
What are fools eager to do?

Foolish people are eager to argue with others.

title: Proverbs 20:6 (#1)
content:
What kind of person is difficult to find?

A faithful person is difficult to find.

title: Proverbs 20:9 (#1)
content:
What is something that no one can truthfully say about himself?

No one can say truthfully that he has made his heart pure and is clean from sin.

title: Proverbs 20:11 (#1)
content:
By what is even a young person known?

Even a young man will show others who he is by what he does.

title: Proverbs 20:13 (#1)
content:
What causes a person to become poor?

If you sleep a lot, you will become poor.

title: Proverbs 20:15 (#1)
content:
What things are rare and precious?

The knowledgeable things that people say are rare and precious.

title: Proverbs 20:17 (#1)
content:
What does food gained by deceit taste like afterward?

Food gained by deceiving others tastes like gravel afterward.

title: Proverbs 20:20 (#1)
content:
What happens to a person who curses his father or mother?

People who curse their parents will be like an oil lamp that is extinguished in a totally dark place.

title: Proverbs 20:22 (#1)
content:
Instead of trying to pay someone back for a wrong, what should you do?

You should wait for Yahweh to resolve the matter, so that he may vindicate you.

title: Proverbs 20:25 (#1)
content:
What is it dangerous to thoughtlessly declare?

It is dangerous to thoughtlessly declare that a man will dedicate something to Yahweh before he considers.

title: Proverbs 20:28 (#1)
content:
What guards a king?

Covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness guard a king.

title: Proverbs 20:29 (#1)
content:
What is the splendor of young men?

The splendor of young men is their strength.

title: Proverbs 21:1 (#1)
content:
What does Yahweh direct wherever he wants them to go?

Yahweh directs what kings think according to all that he desires.

title: Proverbs 21:3 (#1)
content:
What is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice?

To do what is right and fair is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.

title: Proverbs 21:6 (#1)
content:
What happens to the wealth of someone who acquires riches by a speaking falsely?

That wealth quickly vanishes like mist, and doing that will kill the person who lied.

title: Proverbs 21:7 (#1)
content:
Why are the wicked punished?

The wicked are punished because they refuse to do what is right.

title: Proverbs 21:10 (#1)
content:
What is not seen in the eyes of the wicked?

Grace is not seen in the eyes of the wicked.

title: Proverbs 21:11 (#1)
content:
Who learns wisdom when a mocker is punished?

The naive learn wisdom when a mocker is punished.

title: Proverbs 21:14 (#1)
content:
What does a secret gift accomplish?

A secret gift subdues anger.

title: Proverbs 21:16 (#1)
content:
Where does one who wanders from understanding rest?

One who wanders from understanding rests in the assembly of the spirits of the dead.

title: Proverbs 21:19 (#1)
content:
Where is it better to live than with a quarrelsome wife?

It is better to live in the wilderness than with an argumentative, nagging wife.

title: Proverbs 21:22 (#1)
content:
What is a wise man able to bring down?

A wise man is able to bring down the walls that people believe will protect them.

title: Proverbs 21:24 (#1)
content:
What is the name for a proud and haughty person?

A proud and haughty person is called “Mocker.”

title: Proverbs 21:27 (#1)
content:
What kind of sacrifice is detestable?

The sacrifice of a wicked person is detestable, and even more so when he offers it while intending to act wickedly.

title: Proverbs 21:30 (#1)
content:
What things are nothing compared to Yahweh?

Wisdom, understanding, or counsel are nothing compared to Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 21:31 (#1)
content:
Who gives the victory in the day of battle?

Yahweh determines who wins that fight.

title: Proverbs 22:2 (#1)
content:
What do the rich and poor have in common?

Yahweh is the maker of both the rich people and poor people.

title: Proverbs 22:4 (#1)
content:
For what is the reward of riches, honor, and life?

The reward of riches, honor, and life is given to people who are humble and revere Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 22:6 (#1)
content:
If a child is taught the way he should go, what will he not do when he grows old?

If a child is taught how to behave properly, he will not turn away from that training when he grows old.

title: Proverbs 22:7 (#1)
content:
What is the relationship between the one who borrows and the one who lends?

The one who borrows is a slave to the one who lends.

title: Proverbs 22:10 (#1)
content:
What will cease if the mocker is driven away?

Judgment and dishonor will cease if the mocker is driven away.

title: Proverbs 22:13 (#1)
content:
What excuse does a lazy person use not to work?

A lazy person says there is a lion in the streets that will kill him if he goes outside.

title: Proverbs 22:14 (#1)
content:
How dangerous is what an adulterous woman says?

What an adulterous woman says is as dangerous as a deep hole that men could fall into.

title: Proverbs 22:15 (#1)
content:
What drives foolishness from a child?

The rod of discipline drives foolishness from a child.

title: Proverbs 22:19 (#1)
content:
In whom should a person trust?

A person should trust in Yahweh.

title: Proverbs 22:22 (#1)
content:
What must not be done to the poor and suffering?

Do not steal from the poor and do not oppress suffering people.

title: Proverbs 22:23 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do to those who rob the poor?

Yahweh will kill the people who stole from them.

title: Proverbs 22:24–25 (#1)
content:
Why must a person not associate with people who easily become angry?

A person must not associate with someone who easily becomes angry because he will learn to act like them and endanger himself.

title: Proverbs 22:26–27 (#1)
content:
What might a person take from someone who cannot pay back a loan?

A person could take even their bed if they cannot repay the loan.

title: Proverbs 22:28 (#1)
content:
What must not be moved?

The ancient boundary stone set by their ancestors must not be moved.

title: Proverbs 23:1 (#1)
content:
When should a person observe carefully what is before him?

When a person sits to eat with a ruler, he should carefully consider what is before him.

title: Proverbs 23:4 (#1)
content:
A wise person knows when to stop doing what?

A wise person knows when to stop working too hard to try to become rich.

title: Proverbs 23:5 (#1)
content:
How does wealth compare to a bird?

Both wealth and a bird can quickly disappear.

title: Proverbs 23:7 (#1)
content:
Why does a stingy man not mean what he says when he tells you to eat and drink?

Because stingy people are always thinking about how much the food costs them.

title: Proverbs 23:9 (#1)
content:
How does a fool react to insightful words?

A fool despises the insightful things that you say.

title: Proverbs 23:10–11 (#1)
content:
Why should you not claim the land that belongs to orphans?

Their strong redeemer, Yahweh, will defend them when they dispute with you.

title: Proverbs 23:13 (#1)
content:
What should not be withheld from a child?

Discipline should not be withheld from a child.

title: Proverbs 23:15–16 (#1)
content:
What makes a father be deeply joyful?

When his son speaks what is right, the father will be deeply joyful.

title: Proverbs 23:20 (#1)
content:
From whom should a person stay away?

A person should stay away from drunkards or gluttonous eaters.

title: Proverbs 23:23 (#1)
content:
What should a person acquire?

A person should acquire truth, wisdom, instruction, and understanding.

title: Proverbs 23:26 (#1)
content:
What should a son give to his father?

A son should give his father his heart.

title: Proverbs 23:27–28 (#1)
content:
In what way are certain women very dangerous?

Prostitutes and adulterous women are dangerous because they cause many men to become unfaithful.

title: Proverbs 23:29–30 (#1)
content:
What kind of people are woeful, sorrowful, and quarrelsome?

Those people who drink too much wine.

title: Proverbs 23:31–33 (#1)
content:
What will happen when you let wine become overly attractive to you?

When you are drunk, you will hallucinate.

title: Proverbs 23:35 (#1)
content:
What does the drunkard say when he wakes up?

The drunkard says he wishes to be sober so that he could find even more wine to drink again.

title: Proverbs 24:1 (#1)
content:
Of whom should a person not be envious?

A person should not be envious of those who are evil.

title: Proverbs 24:3 (#1)
content:
By what is a household established?

A household is established by wisdom.

title: Proverbs 24:5 (#1)
content:
What can a person add to wisdom to become more powerful?

A wise person who adds knowledge to wisdom makes himself more powerful.

title: Proverbs 24:8 (#1)
content:
What do people call a person who plans to do evil?

People call a person who plans to do evil a schemer.

title: Proverbs 24:10 (#1)
content:
If you give up during distressful times, how is your strength?

If you give up during distressful times, then you are weak.

title: Proverbs 24:12 (#1)
content:
What does God give each person?

God gives each person what he deserves.

title: Proverbs 24:15 (#1)
content:
What do the wicked lie in wait to do?

The wicked lie in wait to attack the places where righteous people dwell.

title: Proverbs 24:17–18 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do if you are glad when your enemy falls?

Yahweh will notice and disapprove, and stop being angry with your enemies.

title: Proverbs 24:20 (#1)
content:
What happens to the lamp of the wicked?

The lamp of the wicked will be extinguished.

title: Proverbs 24:21 (#1)
content:
With whom should a person not associate?

A person should not associate with those who rebel against the king.

title: Proverbs 24:24 (#1)
content:
What will happen to the one who declares that a guilty person is innocent?

Many people will curse him and whole people groups will hate him.

title: Proverbs 24:26 (#1)
content:
What is like a kiss on the lips?

An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

title: Proverbs 24:29 (#1)
content:
What should a person not say about his neighbor?

A person should not say that he will pay back his neighbor for what he has done.

title: Proverbs 24:30–31 (#1)
content:
What did the field of the lazy man look like?

In the lazy man’s field, thistles and weeds were everywhere, and the stone wall surrounding it had broken down.

title: Proverbs 24:34 (#1)
content:
What comes upon the lazy man like a robber?

Poverty and need come upon the lazy man as if a thief has robbed him.

title: Proverbs 25:1 (#1)
content:
Who was the author of this proverb?

Solomon was the author of this proverb.

title: Proverbs 25:2 (#1)
content:
What is it the glory of God to do?

It is the glory of God to make something that is difficult for people to understand.

title: Proverbs 25:5 (#1)
content:
How is the throne of the king established?

People must remove wicked advisers from the presence of the king so that he can rule securely by being righteous.

title: Proverbs 25:6–7 (#1)
content:
What is better than standing in the place designated for the great?

Waiting for the king tell you to come up here is better than standing in the place designated for the great and being told to sit farther away from the king.

title: Proverbs 25:8 (#1)
content:
If you have witnessed something concerning your neighbor, why should you not be quick to bring it to trial?

You should not plead your case too quickly because your neighbor may win the case and embarrass you.

title: Proverbs 25:13 (#1)
content:
What does a reliable messenger do for his senders?

A faithful messenger refreshes the people whom he serves.

title: Proverbs 25:15 (#1)
content:
With what can a leader be persuaded?

A ruler can be persuaded with patience.

title: Proverbs 25:17 (#1)
content:
How could your neighbor feel that he has had too much of you?

Your neighbor could feel that he has had too much of you if you visit his house too often.

title: Proverbs 25:19 (#1)
content:
What is like a a crippled foot?

Trusting treacherous people during distressful times is like a crippled foot.

title: Proverbs 25:21 (#1)
content:
What should you do for your enemy?

You should give your enemy food to eat and water to drink if they are hungry or thirsty.

title: Proverbs 25:22 (#1)
content:
What will Yahweh do for the one who gives his enemy food and drink?

Yahweh will reward the one who gives his enemy food and drink.

title: Proverbs 26:2 (#1)
content:
What does not harm you?

A curse will not harm you if you are innocent.

title: Proverbs 26:4 (#1)
content:
What will happen to you if you reply to foolish people according to their foolish way of thinking?

If you do, then you also will be foolish.

title: Proverbs 26:6 (#1)
content:
What is like cutting off one’s own feet?

Sending a message by the hand of a fool is like cutting off one’s own feet.

title: Proverbs 26:10 (#1)
content:
One who employs a fool is like what?

One who employs a fool is like an archer who randomly shoots arrows at people.

title: Proverbs 26:11 (#1)
content:
Why is a fool like a dog who returns to his vomit?

A fool is like a dog who returns to his vomit because a fool does the same foolish thing over and over again.

title: Proverbs 26:14 (#1)
content:
What is like a door swinging on its hinges?

As a door swings on its hinges and does not go anywhere, so a lazy person turns back and forth in his bed.

title: Proverbs 26:16 (#1)
content:
How does a lazy person appear in his own eyes?

A lazy person wrongly thinks that he is wiser than several people who answer intelligently.

title: Proverbs 26:19 (#1)
content:
